subject: Finexa - SOC 2 evidence and buying process
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Finexa discovery follow-up / next steps

Rachel / Marissa — thanks for joining the call earlier with Finexa. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Finexa is evaluating for a production pilot (payments/transactions enrichment) and needs our SOC 2 report, pen test summary, and sample audit logs to complete their security review.
- Key stakeholders: Asha Rao (security lead), Markus Steiner (VP Product / economic buyer), procurement@finexa.com, legal TBD.
- They asked for evidence and a high-level buying process timeline (procurement windows, contract owner).

Can one of you own preparing the evidence package and sending over a secure link? I'll handle the procurement/contract questions (deal contact: Markus).

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — good call. Confirming next steps from our side: 

- Security will review SOC 2 and the pen test summary; target review window is 7 business days.
- Procurement needs DPA + standard terms; they requested any commercial redlines up front.
- Markus will be the economic approver; target decision date for pilot is end of June if evidence looks good.

Can you send the SOC 2 report and a short (1-page) summary of your security posture? Also a pen test executive summary would be helpful. Please share via a secure link (SFTP or protected Drive).

Asha Rao
Head of Security
Finexa

I'm attaching a short evidence checklist we typically send to security teams and a spreadsheet to capture stakeholder contacts and procurement timelines. Could you please fill in the procurement contact (name/email) and confirm the expected review cadence?

Marissa — procurement and legal want the DPA signed before we pull full artifacts into our environment, but security is OK to review read-only links for the initial pass. I'll loop in procurement separately to confirm our contract owner and timeline.

Procurement contact: Linda Gao <procurement@finexa.com> (she's copied). Our timeline: security review 7 business days, procurement review 3 business days after security concludes. Markus reiterated end-of-June decision goal but notes his availability is limited week of June 22.

If you can provision a read-only Drive link for SOC 2 and pen test exec summary, security will get started. We'll need the formal SOC 2 PDF and pen test archive if we move to procurement.

Thanks,
Asha

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Finexa evidence delivery plan

Team — per Finexa's ask, here's the plan I'm sending to Asha today. Please review and flag anything missing: 

1) Deliver read-only Drive link to: SOC2_Report_2025.pdf, pen_test_summary.zip (exec summary + redactables), and audit-logs-sample.csv (anonymized).
2) Include a 1-page security posture summary and a short note on our retention policy and audit log generation cadence.
3) Ask procurement if they'd prefer DocuSign DPA or countersigned PDF first. If they insist on DPA before artifacts, we'll send the DOC and request an initial review copy via restricted link.
4) Upload full artifacts to our secure SFTP and share link only after procurement sign-off. 

Marissa — can you prepare the Drive link and upload the three items listed above? Ben — please follow up with Markus on the decision timeline and confirm he can review the pilot proposal before June 30.

Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
